svg.title: How knowledge search works: the retrieval pipeline
svg.desc: Eight numbered steps. The queries (1) go to three searches that run side by side: by meaning (2), by words (3) and by file name and heading (4). Their rankings are fused into one list (5). An optional reranker re-reads the best candidates (6), the neighbouring chunks of each hit are added (7), and the passages are numbered so that a citation such as [2] means the same passage everywhere in the run (8). The candidates shown are an invented example.

g.text: Finds passages that mean the same
Finds passages with the same words
Matches section titles and file names
Adds the chunks around each hit
